en: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.
ar: ٱلَّذِيٓ أَطۡعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٖ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنۡ خَوۡفِۭ

nb.en: Let them worship the Lord of this House,

tr: Allathee atAAamahum min jooAAin waamanahum min khawfin

en: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant
ar: لَّيۡسَ لَهُمۡ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٖ

nb.en: They will be given drink from a boiling spring.

tr: Laysa lahum taAAamun illa min dareeAAin

en: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?
ar: أَرَءَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِي يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ

nb.en: For that is the one who drives away the orphan

tr: Araayta allathee yukaththibu bialddeeni

en: Have you not considered, [O Muhammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?
ar: أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡفِيلِ

nb.en: Did He not make their plan into misguidance?

tr: Alam tara kayfa faAAala rabbuka biashabi alfeeli

en: And when We bestow favor upon the disbeliever, he turns away and distances himself; and when evil touches him, he is ever despairing.
ar: وَإِذَآ أَنۡعَمۡنَا عَلَى ٱلۡإِنسَٰنِ أَعۡرَضَ وَنَـَٔا بِجَانِبِهِۦ وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ كَانَ يَـُٔوسٗا

nb.en: And We send down of the Qur'an that which is healing and mercy for the believers, but it does not increase the wrongdoers except in loss.

tr: Waitha anAAamna AAala alinsani aAArada wanaa bijanibihi waitha massahu alshsharru kana yaoosan

en: For you is your religion, and for me is my religion."
ar: لَكُمۡ دِينُكُمۡ وَلِيَ دِينِ

nb.en: Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship.

tr: Lakum deenukum waliya deeni

en: O you who were given the Scripture, believe in what We have sent down [to Muhammad], confirming that which is with you, before We obliterate faces and turn them toward their backs or curse them as We cursed the sabbath-breakers. And ever is the decree of Allah accomplished.
ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ ءَامِنُواْ بِمَا نَزَّلۡنَا مُصَدِّقٗا لِّمَا مَعَكُم مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن نَّطۡمِسَ وُجُوهٗا فَنَرُدَّهَا عَلَىٰٓ أَدۡبَارِهَآ أَوۡ نَلۡعَنَهُمۡ كَمَا لَعَنَّآ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلسَّبۡتِۚ وَكَانَ أَمۡرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفۡعُولًا

nb.en: Among the Jews are those who distort words from their [proper] usages and say, "We hear and disobey" and "Hear but be not heard" and "Ra'ina," twisting their tongues and defaming the religion. And if they had said [instead], "We hear and obey" and "Wait for us [to understand]," it would have been better for them and more suitable. But Allah has cursed them for their disbelief, so they believe not, except for a few.

tr: Ya ayyuha allatheena ootoo alkitaba aminoo bima nazzalna musaddiqan lima maAAakum min qabli an natmisa wujoohan fanaruddaha AAala adbariha aw nalAAanahum kama laAAanna ashaba alssabti wakana amru Allahi mafAAoolan

en: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.
ar: يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتٗا لِّيُرَوۡاْ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ

nb.en: Because your Lord has commanded it.

tr: Yawmaithin yasduru alnnasu ashtatan liyuraw aAAmalahum

en: Then it will be said to them, "Where is that which you used to associate [with Him in worship]
ar: ثُمَّ قِيلَ لَهُمۡ أَيۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تُشۡرِكُونَ

nb.en: In boiling water; then in the Fire they will be filled [with flame].

tr: Thumma qeela lahum ayna ma kuntum tushrikoona

en: Those who disbelieve and avert [people] from the way of Allah - He will waste their deeds.
ar: ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَصَدُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ أَضَلَّ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ

nb.en: And those who believe and do righteous deeds and believe in what has been sent down upon Muhammad - and it is the truth from their Lord - He will remove from them their misdeeds and amend their condition.

tr: Allatheena kafaroo wasaddoo AAan sabeeli Allahi adalla aAAmalahum

en: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs.
ar: رَّبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغۡرِبِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذۡهُ وَكِيلٗا

nb.en: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.

tr: Rabbu almashriqi waalmaghribi la ilaha illa huwa faittakhithhu wakeelan

en: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allah. To Him belongs dominion, and to Him belongs [all] praise, and He is over all things competent.
ar: يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ لَهُ ٱلۡمُلۡكُ وَلَهُ ٱلۡحَمۡدُۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٌ

nb.en: It is He who created you, and among you is the disbeliever, and among you is the believer. And Allah, of what you do, is Seeing.

tr: Yusabbihu lillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi lahu almulku walahu alhamdu wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeerun

en: And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but what good to him will be the remembrance?
ar: وَجِاْيٓءَ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بِجَهَنَّمَۚ يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ

nb.en: And your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank,

tr: Wajeea yawmaithin bijahannama yawmaithin yatathakkaru alinsanu waanna lahu alththikra

en: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone
ar: عَٰلِمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ فَلَا يُظۡهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيۡبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا

nb.en: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period."

tr: AAalimu alghaybi fala yuthhiru AAala ghaybihi ahadan

en: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar.
ar: إِنَّآ أَعۡطَيۡنَٰكَ ٱلۡكَوۡثَرَ

nb.en: So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone].

tr: Inna aAAtaynaka alkawthara

en: Say, "Would you acquaint Allah with your religion while Allah knows whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, and Allah is Knowing of all things?"
ar: قُلۡ أَتُعَلِّمُونَ ٱللَّهَ بِدِينِكُمۡ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٞ

nb.en: The believers are only the ones who have believed in Allah and His Messenger and then doubt not but strive with their properties and their lives in the cause of Allah. It is those who are the truthful.

tr: Qul atuAAallimoona Allaha bideenikum waAllahu yaAAlamu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi waAllahu bikulli shayin AAaleemun

en: They took their [false] oaths as a cover, so they averted [people] from the way of Allah, and for them is a humiliating punishment.
ar: ٱتَّخَذُوٓاْ أَيۡمَٰنَهُمۡ جُنَّةٗ فَصَدُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ مُّهِينٞ

nb.en: Allah has prepared for them a severe punishment. Indeed, it was evil that they were doing.

tr: Ittakhathoo aymanahum junnatan fasaddoo AAan sabeeli Allahi falahum AAathabun muheenun

en: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised -
ar: فَذَرۡهُمۡ يَخُوضُواْ وَيَلۡعَبُواْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ

nb.en: To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone.

tr: Fatharhum yakhoodoo wayalAAaboo hatta yulaqoo yawmahumu allathee yooAAadoona

en: The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have evoked [Your] anger or of those who are astray.
ar: صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ غَيۡرِ ٱلۡمَغۡضُوبِ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ

nb.en: Guide us to the straight path -

tr: Sirata allatheena anAAamta AAalayhim ghayri almaghdoobi AAalayhim wala alddalleena

en: And spend [in the way of Allah] from what We have provided you before death approaches one of you and he says, "My Lord, if only You would delay me for a brief term so I would give charity and be among the righteous."
ar: وَأَنفِقُواْ مِن مَّا رَزَقۡنَٰكُم مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَ أَحَدَكُمُ ٱلۡمَوۡتُ فَيَقُولَ رَبِّ لَوۡلَآ أَخَّرۡتَنِيٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ قَرِيبٖ فَأَصَّدَّقَ وَأَكُن مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ

nb.en: O you who have believed, let not your wealth and your children divert you from remembrance of Allah. And whoever does that - then those are the losers.

tr: Waanfiqoo min ma razaqnakum min qabli an yatiya ahadakumu almawtu fayaqoola rabbi lawla akhkhartanee ila ajalin qareebin faassaddaqa waakun mina alssaliheena

en: There is not upon the blind any guilt or upon the lame any guilt or upon the ill any guilt [for remaining behind]. And whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger - He will admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow; but whoever turns away - He will punish him with a painful punishment.
ar: لَّيۡسَ عَلَى ٱلۡأَعۡمَىٰ حَرَجٞ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلۡأَعۡرَجِ حَرَجٞ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلۡمَرِيضِ حَرَجٞۗ وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ يُدۡخِلۡهُ جَنَّـٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۖ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ يُعَذِّبۡهُ عَذَابًا أَلِيمٗا

nb.en: Say to those who remained behind of the bedouins, "You will be called to [face] a people of great military might; you may fight them, or they will submit. So if you obey, Allah will give you a good reward; but if you turn away as you turned away before, He will punish you with a painful punishment."

tr: Laysa AAala alaAAma harajun wala AAala alaAAraji harajun wala AAala almareedi harajun waman yutiAAi Allaha warasoolahu yudkhilhu jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu waman yatawalla yuAAaththibhu AAathaban aleeman

en: And why should I not worship He who created me and to whom you will be returned?
ar: وَمَالِيَ لَآ أَعۡبُدُ ٱلَّذِي فَطَرَنِي وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ

nb.en: Follow those who do not ask of you [any] payment, and they are [rightly] guided.

tr: Wama liya la aAAbudu allathee fataranee wailayhi turjaAAoona

en: Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them is a reward uninterrupted.
ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونٖ

nb.en: Those who do not give zakah, and in the Hereafter they are disbelievers.

tr: Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lahum ajrun ghayru mamnoonin

en: And they denied him, so We destroyed them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ

nb.en: And we are not to be punished."

tr: Fakaththaboohu faahlaknahum inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

en: No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock -
ar: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمۡ يَنتَهِ لَنَسۡفَعَۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ

nb.en: Does he not know that Allah sees?

tr: Kalla lain lam yantahi lanasfaAAan bialnnasiyati

en: Allah extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. And they rejoice in the worldly life, while the worldly life is not, compared to the Hereafter, except [brief] enjoyment.
ar: ٱللَّهُ يَبۡسُطُ ٱلرِّزۡقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقۡدِرُۚ وَفَرِحُواْ بِٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَمَا ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَا فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ إِلَّا مَتَٰعٞ

nb.en: But those who break the covenant of Allah after contracting it and sever that which Allah has ordered to be joined and spread corruption on earth - for them is the curse, and they will have the worst home.

tr: Allahu yabsutu alrrizqa liman yashao wayaqdiru wafarihoo bialhayati alddunya wama alhayatu alddunya fee alakhirati illa mataAAun

en: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.
ar: فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن يَوۡمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ

nb.en: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their predecessors, so let them not impatiently urge Me.

tr: Fawaylun lillatheena kafaroo min yawmihimu allathee yooAAadoona

en: And the Qur'an is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens].
ar: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوۡلِ شَيۡطَٰنٖ رَّجِيمٖ

nb.en: And Muhammad is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen.

tr: Wama huwa biqawli shaytanin rajeemin

en: But what would make you perceive, [O Muhammad], that perhaps he might be purified
ar: وَمَا يُدۡرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ

nb.en: Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting].

tr: Wama yudreeka laAAallahu yazzakka

en: The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.
ar: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمۡرٖ

nb.en: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.

tr: Tanazzalu almalaikatu waalrroohu feeha biithni rabbihim min kulli amrin
